text:
Maya Patel: quick sync  final readiness for the Nimbus marketplace launch. top items: press window, SI office hours, hero assets, and sandbox access. target Wed 07:00 PT.
Evan Holt: ops: sandbox can be ready by Tue AM if we get tester emails + size. proposed 2x vGPU nodes, 50GB storage, locked egress.
Priya Shah: legal: co-brand consent ok, will need signed consent before any vendor quote goes live. NDA addendum ready if outlet requests early hands-on.
Jonah Reed: creative: need badge SVG + hero (1200x600) + a 1s install GIF. if assets miss the cut we'll use neutral hero + "partner badge coming" pill.
Sofia Morales: marketing: blog draft at 90% waiting on 1-sentence vendor quote and perf blurb. prefer vendor-led quote. embargo proposal: Tue 10am PT to bloggers, Wed 07:00 PT public.
Marco Diaz: ops note: add a routing policy to send heavy inference to Dedicated pool first 48h and fallback to quantized variant if p95 latency > 350ms. I'll add to playbook.
Maya Patel: can we confirm who owns day-0 triage email and SI office hours? want explicit names on the listing.
Evan Holt: eng-platform will own day-0 triage (oncall-eng), SI office hours: Samir Patel + Jonah Reed as backups.
Priya Shah: NDA addendum link: https://redwood.legal/nimbus-handson-addendum v1.0. Partnerships to coordinate signatures.
Jonah Reed: microsite layout: CTA for "SI quickstart" (3 bullets) + office hours ribbon. will reserve slot.
Sofia Morales: PR-bot: we may allow one NDA-protected early hands-on for a single outlet. @Maya please DM outlet name; PR will vet.
PR-bot: embargo checklist: send embargo list + outreach plan by EOD Mon. Only one exception under NDA.
Maya Patel: action recap:
- Partnerships: collect assets + vendor quote (Maya)
- Creative: hero + badge + GIF (Jonah)
- Ops: sandbox + routing policy + fallback (Marco/Evan)
- Legal: NDA/addendum + co-brand consent (Priya)
- Marketing/PR: finalize blog + embargo list (Sofia/PR-bot)
Maya Patel: final blocker check?
Marco Diaz: request one more sandbox credential rotation policy: creds expire 48h. SI lead to own invites.
Maya Patel: ok. I'll compile final checklist and post link here at 13:00 PT. if anything slips we'll push inner validation to Tue AM but keep public date same unless legal/assets slip. :white_check_mark:
